648	def merge_candidate_collisions(candidates: Sequence[IntakeCandidate]) -> list[IntakeCandidate]:
649	    """Merge only exact emitted headword collisions before ledger emission.
650	
651	    A VESUM-unresolved form can have the same normalized key as a resolved
652	    lemma. Case or stress variants must remain separate: their inventory rows
653	    have distinct raw lemmas, and retaining them gives reviewers the uncertain
654	    form instead of changing a known Atlas duplicate's disposition. Exact raw
655	    headword collisions, however, would create duplicate ledger keys at a
656	    shared locator, so they are consolidated deterministically.
657	    """
658	
659	    grouped: dict[str, list[IntakeCandidate]] = defaultdict(list)
660	    for candidate in candidates:
661	        grouped[candidate.lemma].append(candidate)
662	    merged: list[IntakeCandidate] = []
663	    for lemma, group in grouped.items():
664	        if len(group) == 1:
665	            merged.append(group[0])
666	            continue
667	        classifications = {candidate.classification for candidate in group}
668	        classification: Classification = "reject" if "reject" in classifications else "review_queue"
669	        poss = {candidate.pos for candidate in group if candidate.pos}
670	        glosses = {candidate.gloss for candidate in group if candidate.gloss}
671	        reasons = {reason for candidate in group for reason in candidate.reasons}
672	        reasons.add("canonical_headword_collision")
673	        if len(poss) > 1:
674	            reasons.add("vesum_conflicting_pos")
675	        if len(glosses) > 1:
676	            reasons.add("conflicting_english_anchor")
677	        pos = next(iter(poss)) if len(poss) == 1 else None
678	        gloss = next(iter(glosses)) if len(glosses) == 1 else None
679	        merged.append(
680	            IntakeCandidate(
681	                candidate_key=f"merged:{_lemma_key(lemma)}",
682	                lemma=lemma,
683	                forms=tuple(
684	                    sorted(
685	                        {form for candidate in group for form in candidate.forms},
686	                        key=stable_lemma_sort_key,
687	                    )
688	                ),
689	                pos=pos,
690	                gloss=gloss,
691	                records=merge_records(candidate.records for candidate in group),
692	                classification=classification,
693	                reasons=tuple(sorted(reasons)),
694	                heritage_status=next(
695	                    (
696	                        candidate.heritage_status
697	                        for candidate in group
698	                        if candidate.heritage_status is not None
699	                    ),
700	                    None,
701	                ),
702	            )
703	        )
704	    return sorted(
705	        merged,
706	        key=lambda candidate: (candidate.lemma.casefold(), candidate.lemma, candidate.candidate_key),
707	    )
708

710	def merge_records(
711	    record_groups: Iterable[Sequence[SourceInventoryRecord]],
712	) -> tuple[SourceInventoryRecord, ...]:
713	    """Combine same-headword source locations while preserving their total count."""
714	
715	    merged: dict[tuple[str, str, str, str], SourceInventoryRecord] = {}
716	    for records in record_groups:
717	        for record in records:
718	            key = (
719	                record.lemma,
720	                record.source_id or "",
721	                record.source_path or "",
722	                record.source_locator or "",
723	            )
724	            previous = merged.get(key)
725	            merged[key] = record if previous is None else replace(previous, count=previous.count + record.count)
726	    return tuple(
727	        sorted(
728	            merged.values(),
729	            key=lambda record: (
730	                record.source_path or "",
731	                record.source_locator or "",
732	                _lemma_key(record.lemma),
733	                record.lemma,
734	            ),
735	        )
736	    )

739	def build_resolved_candidates(
740	    grouped: Mapping[str, Sequence[TokenOccurrence]],
741	    *,
742	    resolutions: Mapping[str, VesumResolution],
743	    atlas_keys: set[str],
744	    ledger_keys: set[str],
745	    heritage_lookup: HeritageLookup,
746	    inventory_path: str,
747	) -> list[IntakeCandidate]:
748	    drafts: list[tuple[str, str, tuple[str, ...], str | None, str | None, tuple[str, ...], tuple[SourceInventoryRecord, ...]]] = []
749	    for key, occurrences in grouped.items():
750	        forms = tuple(sorted({occurrence.form for occurrence in occurrences}, key=stable_lemma_sort_key))
751	        lemma = resolutions[forms[0]].lemma
752	        if lemma is None:
753	            raise CurriculumIntakeError("resolved candidate lost its VESUM lemma")
754	        poss = {resolutions[form].pos for form in forms if resolutions[form].pos}
755	        resolution_reasons = {resolutions[form].reason for form in forms if resolutions[form].reason}
756	        pos = next(iter(poss)) if len(poss) == 1 and not resolution_reasons else None
757	        glosses = {occurrence.explicit_gloss.strip() for occurrence in occurrences if occurrence.explicit_gloss}
758	        gloss = next(iter(glosses)) if len(glosses) == 1 else None
759	        metadata_reasons = set(resolution_reasons)
760	        if len(poss) > 1:
761	            metadata_reasons.add("vesum_conflicting_pos")
762	        if len(glosses) > 1:
763	            metadata_reasons.add("conflicting_english_anchor")
764	        records = records_for_occurrences(
765	            occurrences,
766	            lemma=lemma,
767	            pos=pos,
768	            gloss=gloss,
769	            inventory_path=inventory_path,
770	        )
771	        drafts.append((key, lemma, forms, pos, gloss, tuple(sorted(metadata_reasons)), records))
772	
773	    candidates: list[IntakeCandidate] = []
774	    for key, lemma, forms, pos, gloss, metadata_reasons, records in drafts:
775	        classification, reasons, heritage_status = classify_resolved_candidate(
776	            lemma=lemma,
777	            pos=pos,
778	            gloss=gloss,
779	            metadata_reasons=metadata_reasons,
780	            atlas_keys=atlas_keys,
781	            ledger_keys=ledger_keys,
782	            heritage_lookup=heritage_lookup,
783	        )
784	        candidates.append(
785	            IntakeCandidate(
786	                candidate_key=f"lemma:{key}",
787	                lemma=lemma,
788	                forms=forms,
789	                pos=pos,
790	                gloss=gloss,
791	                records=records,
792	                classification=classification,
793	                reasons=reasons,
794	                heritage_status=heritage_status,
795	            )
796	        )
797	    return candidates

800	def classify_resolved_candidate(
801	    *,
802	    lemma: str,
803	    pos: str | None,
804	    gloss: str | None,
805	    metadata_reasons: Sequence[str],
806	    atlas_keys: set[str],
807	    ledger_keys: set[str],
808	    heritage_lookup: HeritageLookup,
809	) -> tuple[Classification, tuple[str, ...], Mapping[str, Any] | None]:
810	    lemma_key = _lemma_key(lemma)
811	    if lemma_key in atlas_keys:
812	        return "reject", ("already_in_atlas",), None
813	    if lemma_key in ledger_keys:
814	        return "reject", ("already_in_existing_ledger",), None
815	    if metadata_reasons:
816	        return "review_queue", tuple(metadata_reasons), None
817	    if not pos:
818	        return "review_queue", ("vesum_ambiguous_pos",), None
819	    if not gloss:
820	        return "review_queue", ("missing_english_anchor",), None
821	    try:
822	        heritage = heritage_lookup(lemma)
823	    except Exception:
824	        return "review_queue", ("heritage_lookup_failed",), None
825	    classification = normalised_text(heritage.get("classification")) if isinstance(heritage, Mapping) else None
826	    if not classification:
827	        return "review_queue", ("heritage_unresolved",), None
828	    if bool(heritage.get("is_russianism")) or classification == "russianism":
829	        return "reject", ("heritage_russianism",), heritage
830	    if classification == "surzhyk":
831	        return "reject", ("heritage_surzhyk",), heritage
832	    if bool(heritage.get("russian_shadow")):
833	        return "review_queue", ("heritage_russian_shadow",), heritage
834	    sovietization_risk = heritage.get("sovietization_risk")
835	    if not isinstance(sovietization_risk, int):
836	        return "review_queue", ("heritage_sovietization_risk_unknown",), heritage
837	    if sovietization_risk > 0:
838	        return "review_queue", ("heritage_sovietization_risk",), heritage
839	    if classification != "standard":
840	        return "review_queue", ("heritage_nonstandard_classification",), heritage
841	    return "auto_approve", ("vesum_unique_lemma_pos", "explicit_english_anchor", "heritage_clear"), heritage

147	def read_membership(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
148	    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
149	    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
150	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: unsupported curated membership schema")
151	    members = payload.get("members")
152	    if not isinstance(members, list):
153	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: members must be a list")
154	    validated: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
155	    seen_slugs: set[str] = set()
156	    for index, member in enumerate(members):
157	        if not isinstance(member, dict):
158	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: members[{index}] must be an object")
159	        lemma = _text(member.get("lemma"))
160	        slug = _text(member.get("slug"))
161	        sources = member.get("sources")
162	        if not lemma or not slug or not isinstance(sources, list) or not all(_text(source) for source in sources):
163	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: members[{index}] requires lemma, slug, and sources")
164	        slug_key = _key(slug)
165	        if slug_key in seen_slugs:
166	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: duplicate membership slug {slug!r}")
167	        seen_slugs.add(slug_key)
168	        validated.append({"lemma": lemma, "slug": slug, "sources": sorted({_text(source) for source in sources})})
169	    return validated

172	def apply_membership(entries: list[dict[str, Any]], members: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
173	    """Mark exact public Atlas routes as practice members without admitting cloze."""
174	    by_slug = {_key(entry.get("url_slug")): index for index, entry in enumerate(entries) if _key(entry.get("url_slug"))}
175	    merged = list(entries)
176	    unresolved: list[dict[str, str]] = []
177	    for member in members:
178	        index = by_slug.get(_key(member["slug"]))
179	        if index is None:
180	            unresolved.append({"slug": member["slug"], "reason": "missing_atlas_route"})
181	            continue
182	        target = merged[index]
183	        if _key(target.get("lemma")) != _key(member["lemma"]):
184	            raise ValueError(f"membership lemma does not match Atlas route {member['slug']!r}")
185	        admission = target.get("surface_admission")
186	        merged_admission = dict(admission) if isinstance(admission, dict) else {}
187	        merged_admission["practice"] = True
188	        merged[index] = {**target, "surface_admission": merged_admission, "curated_membership": True}
189	    if unresolved:

442	def _verified_surface_matches(
443	    form: str,
444	    verifier: VesumVerifier,
445	    pos_filter: str | None = None,
446	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
447	    """Look up a source surface without weakening lemma/POS filtering.
448	
449	    Source sentences preserve capitalization and apostrophe spelling exactly,
450	    while VESUM stores dictionary surfaces in normalized lowercase form. Query
451	    both representations, but leave the emitted answer unchanged so the cloze
452	    still reproduces the attested source token.
453	    """
454	    matches: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
455	    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
456	    for variant in _surface_variants(form):
457	        for match in verifier.verify_words([variant], pos_filter).get(variant, []):
458	            if not isinstance(match, dict):
459	                continue
460	            key = (
461	                str(match.get("lemma") or ""),
462	                str(match.get("pos") or ""),
463	                str(match.get("tags") or ""),
464	            )
465	            if key not in seen:
466	                seen.add(key)
467	                matches.append(match)
468	    if not matches and pos_filter:
469	        return _verified_surface_matches(form, verifier)
470	    return matches

477	def _stress_position(stressed: str) -> tuple[str, int | None]:
478	    nfd = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", stressed)
479	    if nfd.count(STRESS_MARK) != 1:

482	    prefix_nfc = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", prefix)
483	    if not prefix_nfc:
